name: Carnibradish
abilityText: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
description: It lures unsuspecting prey with its sweet scent before trapping them with its thorny vines. Once caught, its prey is dragged into its enormous jaws. It seems to be pretty aggresive.
